name: The Wharfe at Ilkley
intro: England's first river bathing water (2020). Sixteen monitored overflows lie upstream within 60 km, three of them within 1.1 km of the sampling point.

meta.warn_at_note: 0.25 is the site's warning line for rivers. Each summary counts hindsight misses and false alarms at it for lakes too, for comparison only: the site gives no E. coli warning at lakes.

hindsight_reasons.before_2024: Taken in 2023: no archived forecast rain exists for that year, so no estimate could be rebuilt.
hindsight_reasons.no_overflow_upstream: No monitored overflow upstream of this bathing water, so the model has no spill input here.
hindsight_reasons.archive_only: Only in the Water Quality Archive, not in the cached bathing-water file the study's rows were built from (most were taken after that file ended on 7 September 2026; a few earlier ones were never listed in it).
hindsight_reasons.not_ea: WET samples are not in the hindsight study.
